def transform_new(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    A=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==4]
    B=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==6]
    ai0,ai1=min(i for i,j in A),max(i for i,j in A)
    aj0,aj1=min(j for i,j in A),max(j for i,j in A)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i,j in A: out[i][j]=4
    bj0,bj1=min(j for i,j in B),max(j for i,j in B)
    bi0,bi1=min(i for i,j in B),max(i for i,j in B)
    if bj0>aj1 or bj1<aj0:
        f=(lambda j: 2*aj1+1-j) if bj0>aj1 else (lambda j: 2*aj0-1-j)
        for i,j in A:
            if 0<=f(j)<w: out[i][f(j)]=4
    else:
        f=(lambda i: 2*ai1+1-i) if bi0>ai1 else (lambda i: 2*ai0-1-i)
        for i,j in A:
            if 0<=f(i)<h: out[f(i)][j]=4
    return out

prog='''def transform(grid):
    grid=[r[:] for r in grid]; h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    A=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==4]
    B=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==6]
    ai0,ai1=min(i for i,j in A),max(i for i,j in A)
    aj0,aj1=min(j for i,j in A),max(j for i,j in A)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i,j in A: out[i][j]=4
    bj0,bj1=min(j for i,j in B),max(j for i,j in B)
    bi0,bi1=min(i for i,j in B),max(i for i,j in B)
    if bj0>aj1 or bj1<aj0:
        f=(lambda j: 2*aj1+1-j) if bj0>aj1 else (lambda j: 2*aj0-1-j)
        for i,j in A:
            if 0<=f(j)<w: out[i][f(j)]=4
    else:
        f=(lambda i: 2*ai1+1-i) if bi0>ai1 else (lambda i: 2*ai0-1-i)
        for i,j in A:
            if 0<=f(i)<h: out[f(i)][j]=4
    return out
'''
